units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:1:6">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᶜ</cite> <he>נפל ק׳ דטיבריא</he> (ed. Krot. <cite ref="S01659"><he>קסיטולין</he></cite>, corr. acc.) the castle of Tiberias fell in (burying the idol placed therein).
<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 4:6">Tosef. Mikv. IV, 6</cite> <he>ק׳ המחליק מים וכ׳</he> a reservoir which distributes water (in pipes) in the cities.
